not_home1_nanna.text: Ay up me duck, come in. 'Me duck' is a Nottingham hello. It is not about birds, though we have those too.
If somebody is 'mardy' they are in a grump. A 'jitty' is a narrow alley between houses. A 'cob' is a bread roll. It is not a swan.
Meet people at the Left Lion outside the Council House. It is one of two stone lions guarding the Council House, which opened in 1929, and folk have met there ever since.

then.text: You have had your tart, me duck. I will not spoil you. Much.

else.text: My cousin sends a Bakewell tart from Derbyshire every month. I cannot eat them all. Here, you have one.
